skills.name: Writing a short song or poem

worked_example.problem: Plan a short poem about a village festival.
steps: List images: drums beating, dancers in feathers, smoke of roasted corn.
Write short lines with rhymes: drum / come; light / night.
Add a chorus to repeat: “Come, come, the festival has come!”
worked_example.answer: Title → images → short rhyming lines → chorus → read aloud

cards.idea: Rhyme: words ending with the same sound.
A simile compares with like or as.
A chorus is repeated after each verse of a song.
example: Come, come, the festival has come!

questions.prompt: Put the steps of writing a poem in order.

items.text: Read it aloud and improve it

paper_task.prompt: Write a short song or poem (two or three stanzas of four lines, or verses with a chorus) in your exercise book about a festival, your village or a person you love. Use rhyme and at least one simile.
model:
Festival Day

The drums begin at the break of light,
The dancers shine in feathers bright;
The old men smile, the children run,
Their faces glowing like the sun.

Chorus: Come, come, the festival has come!
Dance to the rhythm of the drum!

The smoke of corn floats through the air,
The Fon sits proudly in his chair;
We sing the songs our fathers knew,
Our culture old, our hearts still new.
checklist: It is written in short lines grouped in stanzas.
I used at least one simile (like / as).
I used images that help the reader see or hear.
I read it aloud and improved it.
